topic: Uniform Energy Factor of gas storage water heaters, standby heat loss, and UK combi boiler efficiency

findings.what: ENERGY STAR minimum UEF for gas storage water heaters, >20 and <=55 gallon tanks
findings.quote: For gas storage water heaters with a tank volume greater than 20 gallons and 55 gallons or less, ENERGY STAR requires a UEF of at least 0.81 for the Medium Draw Pattern and 0.86 for the High Draw Pattern.

findings.what: ENERGY STAR minimum UEF for gas storage water heaters, >55 gallon tanks
findings.quote: For tanks greater than 55 gallons, the requirement is UEF >= 0.86.

findings.what: ENERGY STAR certified gas storage water heater minimum First Hour Rating and warranty requirement
findings.quote: ENERGY STAR certified gas storage water heaters must have a First Hour Rating (FHR) of at least 51 gallons per hour and a warranty of 6 years or more on the system including parts.

findings.what: DOE 2024 Final Rule on residential gas-fired storage water heater efficiency standards (20-55 gal units get UEF increase; >55-100 gal unchanged; new standards for >100 gal; effective 2029)
findings.value: 8-16% more efficient depending on size category
findings.quote: the standard will require gas-fired water heaters to be 8% to 16% more efficient depending on the size category... The rule does not affect utility programs until it takes effect in 2029.

findings.what: Example maker-published standby loss figure, A.O. Smith spec sheet (100-gallon commercial-type model)
findings.quote: A 100-gallon model has 80% efficiency and 1146 BTU/hr standby loss.

findings.what: A.O. Smith general compliance statement on standby loss requirements
findings.quote: A.O. Smith gas water heaters meet the thermal efficiency and standby loss requirements of the U.S. Department of Energy and current edition of ASHRAE/IESNA 90.1.

findings.what: Example maker-published standby loss figure, Rheem GHE75S*-100 model
findings.quote: For a Rheem GHE75S*-100 model, the standby loss specification is 900 Btu/hr.

findings.what: UK minimum legal boiler efficiency (ErP rating) for new gas boiler installations since April 2018, equivalent to A-rated
findings.quote: 92% efficiency is equivalent to 'A' rated under the ErP system. As of April 2018, you cannot install a gas boiler with an ErP rating under 92%.

findings.what: SEDBUK minimum seasonal efficiency still used for new-build boilers under current building regs
findings.quote: SEDBUK is still used for boilers in new build homes under the current building regulations and requires a seasonal efficiency of at least 89.5%.

findings.what: Combined (boiler ErP + heating controls) stated efficiency range for combi boilers
findings.quote: Combi boiler owners will believe they have a boiler with an ErP rating of between 92-94%, paired with a heating control of between 1-5%, offering a combined heating efficiency of between 93-99%.

findings.what: Energy Saving Trust field study: real-world performance of A-rated condensing boilers, vs. their stated rating
findings.value: none of 40 tested boilers hit their stated rating; 83% ran at 75-85% actual efficiency
findings.quote: a detailed field study by the Energy Saving Trust found that out of 40 A-rated condensing boilers tested over 12 months, none operated at their stated rating. Instead, 83% were found to be operating between 75% and 85% efficiency.
